verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's own features page lists wallet-style gateways it integrates with, including PayPal and Amazon Pay, alongside WooPayments and Stripe. Nothing shows Apple Pay, Google Pay, express buttons, or a one-click flow that avoids re-entering details. Missing for 10: explicit Apple Pay/Google Pay support, documented express/one-click checkout that skips re-entry of details, platform-native one-click wallet, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can pay with accelerated wallets — Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, platform one-click — without re-entering details

citations.quote: there are 140 region-specific gateways to choose from and integrate with, including WooPayments, Stripe, PayPal, Square, and Amazon Pay
